name: Välismaalasele rahvusvahelise kaitse andmise seadus
name_en: Act on Granting International Protection to Aliens

sections.title: Rahvusvahelise kaitse mõisted
sections.body: Definitions: refugee status, subsidiary protection, temporary protection. Key EU directives: 2011/95/EU (qualification), 2013/32/EU (procedures), 2013/33/EU (reception conditions).

sections.title: Rahvusvahelise kaitse taotluse esitamine
sections.body: Application for international protection must be submitted to PPA (border or territorial). Applicant registered, biometric data collected.

sections.title: Taotluse läbivaatamine
sections.body: Examination of application by PPA. Determines refugee status or subsidiary protection.

sections.title: Taotluse läbivaatamise tähtaeg
sections.body: Examination deadline: 6 months from acceptance; extendable up to 9 additional months for complex cases; maximum 21 months total.

sections.title: Ilmselgelt põhjendamatu taotlus
sections.body: Unfounded applications – specific grounds for summary rejection.

sections.title: Ilmselgelt põhjendamatu taotlus kiirendatud menetluses
sections.body: Manifestly unfounded application in accelerated procedure – shorter deadlines, limited appeal rights.

sections.title: Välistamise alused
sections.body: Exclusion grounds: war crimes, crimes against humanity, serious non-political crimes, acts against UN purposes.

sections.title: Otsuse vaidlustamise tähtaeg
sections.body: Appeal deadline: 10 days from notification of rejection decision. Expedited procedure: even shorter deadlines apply.

sections.title: Kinnipidamine
sections.body: Detention of asylum seekers – grounds include identity verification, protection of national security, risk of absconding. Up to 18 months with court approval.

sections.title: Elamisloa andmine
sections.body: Residence permit granted to refugees (3 years initial, renewable) and to subsidiary protection beneficiaries (1 year initial, renewable).

sections.title: Perekonna taasühinemine
sections.body: Family reunification rights for recognised refugees and subsidiary protection beneficiaries.

sections.title: Tagasisaatmise keeld
sections.body: Non-refoulement principle – absolute prohibition of return to persecution or serious harm.

sections.title: Ajutise kaitse kindlaksmääramine
sections.body: Temporary protection determined by Government of Estonia following EU Council decision (e.g. Ukraine 2022+).
